scope: Separately frozen matched series, one observation per task and condition. Original v1/v2 seven-pair series and, when requested, the finite three-delivery-pair guidance followup remain separately reported. Descriptive, not a statistical or billed-cost claim.
policy: All original dispatches and failures retained. Only both arms of the invalid v1 prior670 pair excluded from matched aggregates. Missing usage is null, never zero.
sourceModes: Exact bytes and native file/executable class. Native private ordinary files may be0600 and Git working files0644. Raw permission bits do not define equivalent source identities.
tokenAccounting: Uncached input = reported total input minus cached input. Reasoning output reported separately, not added again to output. Interrupted v1 Forge prior670 lacks turn.completed usage; aggregate known sums are lower bounds with unavailable counts.
commandAccounting: Distinct command_execution item IDs, including incomplete commands. Several shell subcommands in one execution count once. File-change tool items are not command executions. Original tool events remain private receipts.
historicalProtocols: Original plans retain predispatch not-run status and hashes. This measured results artifact records their subsequent dispatch. Before any v2 model session, authoritative fixture parity replaced the invalid prior670 bootstrap: preserve original AGENTS and670 tracked files via explicit native Git import; do not apply the frozen plan's older AGENTS-rewrite sentence. The separately frozen guidance plan has3 actual pairs,6 sessions; its copied seven-observation limitation sentence is stale historical text, not an additional dispatched scope.
limitations: One sequential observation per task and condition; cache, model-server latency and OS variance can differ.
v1 dispatch overlapped other full verification; wall time is descriptive and resource contention is a confound.
v2 uses narrower skill routing, optional finish, existing configured check pins and short launcher together; changes cannot be causally isolated.
Cold means no graph index, not cold OS/file caches. Warm preparation is explicitly measured and included.
Read-only source investigation and complete recorded delivery are separate outcomes. No independent-human acceptance is claimed.
Git bootstrap is an optional compatibility boundary; native Source and Work remain authoritative in Forge arms.
No provider, hosted-egress, GitHub publication, new paid service or billed-dollar inference occurs in these trials.
v2 source agents chose ordinary source/search/Node reads, including the warm graph arm. Cache savings here do not demonstrate graph-context savings.

External hidden grading and administrative experiment construction are outside participant timings; attributable totals cover measured task, owner/bootstrap/check/warm setup and shared package/skill/launcher installation.
